assumptions: Uses toolkit arcade_shooter runtime through createGame adapter.
Runtime fixed tick is 60 Hz; diagonal input is normalized by the toolkit.
Public player/enemy fixture positions are mapped from [x,y] or x/y fields.
Shooting uses the runtime default upward aim; collision and event ordering are delegated to its rules.
Added the same-instance acceptance snapshot/step/frame/log hook around the rendered game and preserved the actual held movement/fire sampler path.

Public bounds use [originX,originY,width,height]; player, enemy and projectile positions are adapted into local runtime coordinates and projected back to public coordinates. Public seeded projectiles without velocity are stationary until a declared velocity is supplied.
